ei.title: All of the restaurants are using carefully chosen
ei.subject: 6월 고2 모의고사
ei.lesson: All of the restaurants are using carefully chosen

fullPassage: All of the restaurants are using carefully chosen words to evoke vivid mental images of delicious food and rich desserts in order to draw the potential customer to their particular establishment. Just like the restaurants, nature has its own dining establishments. In a fashion similar to the restaurants' financial dependence upon drawing in many customers, the restaurateurs of the natural world (i.e., flowers) must also attract potential diners to sample their offerings. In the natural world, there are no neon signs or flashy words in which to market a potential meal to hungry animals. These restaurants that I am referring to are the world's flowers, and the potential guests are the host of organisms that visit flowers to obtain nectar and other valuable resources. Instead of using a written language or neon sign, they advertise their offerings just as effectively using the language of smell.

questions.passage: All of the restaurants are using carefully chosen words to evoke (A)[vague / vivid] mental images of delicious food and rich desserts in order to draw the potential customer to their particular establishment. Just like the restaurants, nature has its own dining establishments. In a fashion similar to the restaurants' financial dependence upon drawing in many customers, the restaurateurs of the natural world (i.e., flowers) must also (B)[attract / repel] potential diners to sample their offerings. In the natural world, there are no neon signs or flashy words in which to market a potential meal to hungry animals. These restaurants that I am referring to are the world's flowers, and the potential guests are the host of organisms that visit flowers to obtain nectar and other (C)[worthless / valuable] resources. Instead of using a written language or neon sign, they advertise their offerings just as effectively using the language of smell.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ vivid — attract — valuable: 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ① vague — attract — valuable: vague는 선명한(vivid)의 반대(모호한)
❌ ② vivid — repel — valuable: repel은 끌어들이다(attract)의 반대(쫓아내다)
❌ ③ vivid — attract — worthless: worthless는 귀중한(valuable)의 반대(무가치한)
(A) vivid: '선명한'. vague는 '모호한'으로 반대.
(B) attract: '끌어들이다'. repel은 '쫓아내다'로 반대.
(C) valuable: '귀중한'. worthless는 '무가치한'으로 반대.
det.tip: 각 빈칸의 문맥을 파악하세요.

questions.passage: All of the restaurants are using carefully chosen words to evoke vivid mental images of delicious food and rich desserts in order to draw the potential customer to their particular establishment. Just like the restaurants, nature has its own dining establishments. In a fashion similar to the restaurants' financial dependence upon __________, the restaurateurs of the natural world (i.e., flowers) must also attract potential diners to sample their offerings. In the natural world, there are no neon signs or flashy words in which to market a potential meal to hungry animals. These restaurants that I am referring to are the world's flowers, and the potential guests are the host of organisms that visit flowers to obtain nectar and other valuable resources. Instead of using a written language or neon sign, they advertise their offerings just as effectively using the language of smell.
